items.header: D1 — who writes an orchestrator's spawn rows
items.question: The supervisor writes spawn.usage (agent, role, result) for an orchestrator, and the hook writes the orchestrator's spawn.end?
options: The supervisor switches to spawn.usage; the hook writes spawn.end for every sdd-* agent, orchestrators included
Keep the supervisor's spawn.end and have the hook skip orchestrators (no orchestrator usage, against the entry)
Both write spawn.end (the second row finds no open node at ledger.ts:241 and its result is lost)

items.header: D5 — runs the usage report covers
items.question: harness usage sums every run in a ledger, not only the last run.start?
options: All runs, one flat table per spec with the run count in the header
The last run only, as --watch does (question-gates loses 777,748 tokens)

items.header: D4 — where the generated agent profiles live at run time
items.question: The profiles ship inside dist/ and ledger.ts resolves them relative to its own module, empty table on absence?
options: Copy at build into dist/, resolve relative to the module, empty table when missing
Import through resolveJsonModule from harness/ (outside rootDir ./src)

items.question: The tier change is verified and documented, not re-applied?
options: Treat commit 599bdca (2026-09-18) as the delivery; this spec fixes the docs and the ledger table
Re-edit the five agent files under this spec

items.header: D3 — the model value on spawn.end
items.question: model is the distinct message.model values seen, first-seen order, joined with +?
options: All distinct values joined with +, so a mid-spawn substitution shows
